summary: The registrant, Deutsche Mortgage Asset Receiving Corporation, filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that effective October 14, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer for the Prudential Plaza mortgage loan and related pari passu and subordinate notes in the COMM 2015-CCRE26 securitization. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of CMBS CCR, LLC, the directing holder. The change concerns servicing administration if the loan becomes specially serviced; servicing remains governed by the applicable PSA. No economic terms or board recommendation were disclosed.
